_comment: What check-file-hygiene.mjs must not read in THIS repository. The CHECKER lives
here, in tools/, and is run by all three repositories; the RULE travels and the
exemptions stay home, so a checker three repositories share never carries one
repository's exclusion list. buses-data OA-241 states the convention; this file
Until 2026-09-18 this repository declared nothing and got the bare rules over its
whole tracked corpus, which was right and cost nothing. Vendoring a small map
estate into make-bus-leaflet/test/fixtures/estate/ changed that: 73 of its files
are generator output with no final newline, and they are COPIES of packs in
buses-data, which excuses the same folders for the same reason. Fixing them here
would make the copy differ from what the engine draws and turn the fixture check
red for ever; excusing them keeps the copy honest.
